name: AI Deep Dive — EQT — 2026-05-02
rationale: EQT Corporation is the largest natural gas producer in the US, exhibiting strong operational excellence with a Piotroski F-Score of 8. The company is generating massive free cash flow ($2.8B TTM) on $8.3B in revenue with robust 24% net margins. At 11x trailing earnings and 12.5x forward P/E, it is trading at a very reasonable valuation for a commodity producer executing at this level. Weighted PV of $68.45 indicates solid upside and margin of safety.

aiThesis.rationale: EQT stands out as a highly efficient operator in the cyclical oil & gas exploration sector. An exceptional Piotroski F-Score of 8 highlights comprehensive financial health across profitability, leverage, and operating efficiency. Producing $2.8B in FCF gives management massive flexibility for share buybacks and debt reduction. Natural gas prices drive the terminal value here, but EQT's scale and low extraction costs provide a significant structural moat. The base case models modest 12% revenue growth and 25% margins, returning a $71 PV. The stock is a strong BUY for commodity exposure and dividend/buyback potential.
